judged_text: Google credentials corrupted on every token refresh: parseRefreshTokenResponse() returns the full zod safeParse result ({ success, data }) instead of the parsed data, and the Google Calendar path assigns it directly to credential.key and persists it via prisma.credential.update, so after the first access-token refresh the stored key no longer matches googleCredentialSchema and Google Calendar breaks for every user until they re-auth

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (e.g. `{ success, data, error }`), not `data` itself. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That would store the safeParse wrapper into `credential.key`, corrupting the stored credential format (no longer matching the expected Google credential shape) after a refresh.
